spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Amble is a 12th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). Amble has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
entries: At the start of a short or long rest, Amble can touch a point in space, and an {@condition invisible}, 30-foot-radius sphere of magic appears, centered on that point. {@quickref Cover||3||Total cover} blocks the sphere.

While within the sphere, Amble and their allies gain a +5 bonus toDextérité ({@skill Discrétion}) andSagesse ({@skillPerception}) checks, and any light from open flames in the sphere isn't visible outside it.
The sphere vanishes at the end of the rest or lorsque Amble leaves the sphere.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Amble can hold their breath for up to 1 heure at a time.

trait.name: Balm of the Summer Court (12d6)
entries: (As a Bonus Action) Amble can choose une créature they can see within 120 mètres of them and spend up to {@dice 6d6} of their die pool. Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target regains a number oftouché points equal to the total. The target also gains 1 temporarytouché point per die spent. Amble regains all expended dice lorsque they finish a long rest.

trait.name: Hidden Paths (4/Day)
entries: (As a Bonus Action) Amble may teleport up to 60 mètres to an unoccupied space they can see.

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
entries: Amble magically polymorphs into a beast with a challenge rating of 1 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 6 hours. Amble's equipment melds with their new form. Amble reverts to their true form if they die or fall {@condition inconscient}. Amble can revert to their true form using a bonus action on their turn.

Amble's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but they retain their alignment, personality, andIntelligence,Sagesse, andCharisme scores. Amble also retains all their skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of la créature. If la créature has the same proficiency as Amble and the bonus in its stat block is higher, use la créature's bonus instead of Amble's.

When Amble transforms, they assume the beast'stouché points and Touché Dice. When Amble reverts to their normal form, they return to the number oftouché points they had before they transformed. However, if Amble reverts as a result of dropping to 0touché points, any excessdgts carries over their normal form.

Amble can't cast spells, and their ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of their beast form. Transforming doesn't break Amble's {@status concentration} on a spell they've already cast however, or prevent them from taking actions that are part of a spell.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}4 ({@dégât 1d4 + 2}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher ({@hit 8} pour toucher with shillelagh), allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}5 ({@dégât 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoningdgts, or 8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts with shillelagh.

items.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: Fhenimore has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

action.replace: Voice of the Kraken (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

items.name: Multiattack
entries: Fhenimore can attack once with her bite attack and once with Thunderous Touch.

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gar is a 13th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following druid spells prepared:
footerEntries: *Circle spells don't count against spells prepared.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: Gar can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Gar fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Marche sur l'eau
entries: Gar can stand and move on liquid surfaces comme si they were solid ground.

trait.name: Watery Fall
entries: When Gar drops to 0touché points, his body collapses into a pool of inky water that rapidly disperses. Except for {@item Wave} and his claw, anything he was wearing or carrying is left behind.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gar makes two melee attacks, one with his claw and one with {@item Wave}.

action.name: Griffe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}10 ({@dégât 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoningdgts, and la cible is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 16}). Until the grapple ends, Gar can't attack other creatures with his claw.

action.name: Wave
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 20/60 m,, une cible. {@h}9 ({@dégât 1d6 + 6}) piercingdgts or 10 ({@dégât 1d8 + 6}) piercingdgts lorsque used with two hands. If Gar scores a criticaltouché with this weapon, la cible takes extra necroticdgts equal to half itstouché point maximum.

action.name: Umberlee's Wake {@recharge 5}
entries: Power ripples out in a 60-foot radius sphere from a point within portée (150 m,) as the will of Umberlee affects all in her watery embrace. Each creature in that area doit réussir on a {@dd 18}jet de sauvegarde Constitution. On a failed save, la créature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, la créature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save. This only affects targets that are submerged or floating in water. Gar Shatterkeel and any undead serving him are immune to this effect.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Gar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Gar makes one attack with his claw.

legendary.name: Wave (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Gar makes one attack with {@item Wave} with advantage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Shoalar's innate spellcasting ability is Constitution (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Shoalar is a 7th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He knows the following sorcerer spells:

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: Shoalar can breathe air and water.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or ranged 20/60 m,, une cible. {@h}3 ({@dégât 1d4 + 1}) piercingdgts.

action.replace: Voice of the Kraken (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

items.name: Ink Cloud
entries: While underwater, Whymsee can expel an ink cloud in a 20-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than kraken priests or a kraken. Each creature other than a kraken priest or a kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of Whymsee's next turn.

items.name: Shell Defense
entries: Whymsee withdraws into her shell. Until she emerges, she gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in her shell, Whymsee is {@condition prone}, her speed is 0 and can't increase, she has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action she can take is a bonus action to emerge.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes two tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}20 ({@dégât 3d8 + 7}) piercingdgts.

If la cible is a Medium or smaller creature {@condition agrippé} by the kraken, that creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, la créature is {@condition aveuglé} and {@condition entravé}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 21 ({@dégât 6d6}) aciddgts at the start of each of the kraken's turns. One Medium or two smaller creatures can be swallowed at the same time.

Si  kraken takes 35dgts or more on a single turn from une créature inside it, the kraken doit réussir on a {@dd 23}jet de sauvegarde Constitution at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition à terre} in spaces within 10 mètres of the kraken. Si  kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition entravé} by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 mètres of movement, exiting {@condition à terre}.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} pour toucher, allonge 20 m,, une cible. {@h}17 ({@dégât 3d6 + 7}) bludgeoningdgts, and la cible is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 20}). Until the grapple ends, la cible is {@condition entravé}. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple une cible.

action.name: Projeter
entries: One Medium or smaller object held or creature {@condition agrippé} by the kraken is thrown up to 40 mètres in a random direction and knocked {@condition à terre}. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, la cible takes 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) bludgeoningdgts for every 10 mètres it was thrown. If la cible is thrown at another creature, that creature doit réussir on a {@dd 13}Dextérité saving throw or take the samedgts and be knocked {@condition à terre}.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: The kraken magically create a bolt of lightning, which can strike a target the kraken can see within 90 mètres of it. The target doit faire a {@dd 18}Dextérité saving throw, taking 22 ({@dégât 4d10}) lightningdgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.
